newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran evacuates some quake-hit areas amid frost.
newsitem.headline: Iran evacuates some quake-hit areas amid frost.

text.p: Relief workers in Iran were evacuating people from snow-filled mountains after last month's earthquake that killed about 1,000 people and left 36,000 homeless in northwest Iran, newspapers and a United Nations report said on Monday.

The report by the U.N. Resident Coordinator Michael Schulenburg said more than a metre (yard) of snow along with extreme temperature made it impossible for the relief operation in the mountains to continue.
Instead, workers were evacuating people from villages in the highland areas. The February 28 quake measured 5.5 on the Richter scale.
Tehran radio said the province was Iran's coldest region with temperatures of minus 28 degrees Celsius (-18.4 Fahrenheit) in its capital, the city of Ardabil.
